content.title: A Multi-Level Teleconnection and Dynamic Coupling Diagnostic Framework: Decoupling Stratospheric Wave Geometry and Eurasian Blocking via the SDI–BI–CI–EI Suite (1940–2026)
content.abstract: Classical univariate teleconnection metrics frequently fail to capture the non-linear, vertical, and sub-seasonal coupling between middle-stratospheric momentum deposition and lower-tropospheric boundary conditions across the Euro- Mediterranean domain. This paper presents the comprehensive formulation, epistemological justification, and physical validation of the SDI–BI–CI–EI Suite, an integrated multi-level diagnostic system standardized on a continuous, dimensionless metric spanning from minus four to plus four and verified across an uninterrupted historical matrix of 1,041 empirical record
